scripts.build:frontend: vite build && mkdir -p backend/web/dist && cp -R frontend-dist/. backend/web/dist/
scripts.build: pnpm build:frontend && mkdir -p dist && cd backend && go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../dist/hilink-sms ./cmd/server
scripts.test: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm test:go && vitest run
scripts.fmt: oxfmt frontend/src vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tests package.json frontend/package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check frontend/src vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tests package.json frontend/package.json tsconfig.json
